test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an exam, a student got 40 marks and still failed by 20 percent marks. If the passing percentage is 40 percent, then what are the maximum marks of the exam?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Student's scored percentage = Passing percentage − Failing gap percentage

Scored percentage = 40% − 20% = 20%

Since 20% of the maximum marks corresponds to the 40 marks obtained:

Maximum marks = (40 ÷ 20) × 100 = 200

**∴ The correct answer is 200 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks obtained by the student = 40 marks

Failing gap = 20% of maximum marks

Passing percentage = 40% of maximum marks

**Formula Used:**

Passing Marks = Obtained Marks + Shortfall Marks
